keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Topics to find creators for, for example 'budgeting for beginners'. Each one is searched on Brave Search (Google as a fallback) restricted to tiktok.com.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags to find creators for, with or without the # sign, for example budgeting.

excludeWords.title: Leave out results mentioning
excludeWords.description: Optional. A search result whose title or snippet contains one of these words is dropped (for example course, coach).

searchModifiers.title: Extra search words
searchModifiers.description: Optional words added to every search query to steer it, for example 'creator'.

maxSearchPages.title: Search result pages per query
maxSearchPages.description: Pages of search results read for each query wording (a page holds about 10 to 15 TikTok accounts).

maxSearchSeconds.title: Search time budget (seconds)
maxSearchSeconds.description: No new search is started after this time. Requests to Brave Search are spaced about 5 seconds apart and a rate-limit answer is waited out, so allow about 30 seconds per keyword.

maxCreators.title: Maximum creators returned
maxCreators.description: Hard cap on creators per run (and on profiles looked up).

enrichProfiles.title: Add profile data
enrichProfiles.description: Runs your TikTok Profile and Video Stats Actor in profileOnly mode for the creators found and adds followers, likes, bio, bio link and e-mails. Its compute is billed to your account.

profileActor.title: Profile Actor
profileActor.description: Actor used for the profile data: its ID or username/name. It must accept usernames and mode (profileOnly) and return rows with rowType profile.

minFollowers.title: Minimum followers
minFollowers.description: Optional. Needs 'Add profile data'. Creators below this are marked passesFilters false.

maxFollowers.title: Maximum followers
maxFollowers.description: Optional. Needs 'Add profile data'. Creators above this are marked passesFilters false.

onlyPassing.title: Return only creators inside the follower range
onlyPassing.description: Off returns every creator found with passesFilters true, false or null (null = followers unknown).

examPresets.title: Exam presets
examPresets.description: Optional starting keywords and hashtags for common exams, added to your own. Choose any of: igcse, sat, ib, ap, a_level.

regions.title: Preferred countries
regions.description: Optional two-letter country codes (AE, SA, QA, GB, US...). Needs 'Add profile data': a creator's country comes from their profile. See 'How to match them' below.

languages.title: Preferred languages
languages.description: Optional language codes (en, ar...). Needs 'Add profile data'.

matchMode.title: How to match them
matchMode.description: prefer: creators from the chosen countries/languages come first and the rest follow. only: creators confirmed to be elsewhere are left out (creators whose country is unknown are kept and marked).

addMedianViews.title: Add median views of recent videos
addMedianViews.description: Runs your profile Actor in full mode to read the creator's recent videos and adds the median views, so you can judge reach. Costs more than profile-only mode.

videosForMedian.title: Videos for the median
videosForMedian.description: How many of the newest videos the median is taken over (1-10; TikTok's public embed shows up to 10).

minMedianViews.title: Minimum median views
minMedianViews.description: Optional. Creators whose median views are below this are marked passesFilters false. Turns on the median views lookup.

maxMedianViews.title: Maximum median views
maxMedianViews.description: Optional. Creators whose median views are above this are marked passesFilters false. Turns on the median views lookup.
